description: This dataset contains detailed seismic core measurements collected during a geological survey event identified as MSM44_362-1. The records include specific depth intervals, core diameter deviations, and P-wave travel times, alongside derived values such as Vp-a and AGR. Each entry is georeferenced with precise latitude, longitude, and elevation coordinates, all captured on July 12, 2015. The data is organized by sediment depth and section categories, providing a structured view of subsurface properties. Researchers can utilize this collection to analyze seismic wave propagation characteristics, assess core sample integrity, and model geological structures in the surveyed region.
